intro.text: An upscale restaurant in Elendel with a Roughs theme, where Feder Way meets Seventy-Third.

description.text: Outside hang a wooden sign and a window of mannequins dressed for the Roughs. Staff wear Roughs-style hats, bright red shirts and chaps, though the greeter wears an ordinary suit. The decor manages to be both fancy and awful, down to boot-shaped salt shakers of fine quality.
For all the kitsch, diners tend to dress well and are expected to behave with decorum.

items.text: Ranette, her partner Jaxy and Wayne ate here at Jaxy's choice. She found the place amusing, while Ranette and Wayne, both from the Roughs, mocked its fake frontier look as insulting. Over vodka the friends talked through Wayne's troubles, and he walked out before the food came.
